# Bundled browser assets

Versions are pinned in `versions.json`. These assets are served locally; no CDN is needed at runtime.

- Tesseract.js / Tesseract.js-core: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js (Apache-2.0).
- English and Korean best_int traineddata: @tesseract.js-data/eng and @tesseract.js-data/kor, 1.0.0 (Apache-2.0; https://github.com/naptha/tessdata).
- PDF.js: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js (Apache-2.0).
- NanumSquareNeo regular: Ubuntu fonts-nanum 20250212-1, SIL OFL 1.1; see Nanum-LICENSE.

Upstream license notices are included alongside the assets.
